title: Canada's Carney says US curbs on Anthropic models show AI dependence risk
summary: Ahead of the G7, PM Mark Carney cited the US order that took Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 offline as evidence allies must diversify away from dependence on a few US AI models.
reason: Allied leader openly frames US AI controls as a sovereignty risk; a rift signal, words only. Context: the US imposed the export controls on Jun 12 (pre-window) after a reported Fable 5 jailbreak.

title: Cambridge team reports AI-designed vaccine component passes first human trial

reason: AI-for-science milestone; early-stage and lightly sourced.
